summary: Indivior Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on May 4, 2026, disclosing entry into an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with Barclays Bank PLC to repurchase $175 million of its common stock under a previously authorized $400 million buyback program. The company paid the prepayment amount and received an initial delivery of 3,717,473 shares. Final settlement, based on volume-weighted average prices less a discount, is expected by June 22, 2026, with potential additional shares or cash adjustment. The filing indicates a commitment to returning capital to shareholders, typical of special-situation capital returns.
